objective: A second admin menu that adds any animal or variant to the admin's own ranch at a chosen stat level, so ranch features and fights can be tried without hatching.
acceptance_criteria: Only an admin (the game's owner, or anyone in Studio) can add animals; the server checks it and the numbers
Any species or variant can be added at stat level 1, 10, 35 or the maximum, joins the team like a hatched animal, and shows in the Animals panel and the herd
The Barn's limit is skipped, the save's limit of 100 animals is not
No other profile field changes (coins, eggs, XP, upgrades)
verification: lune 688/688, selene and stylua clean. Studio (2026-11-15): added a jackal at level 10 and a Pharaoh Jackal at 70 through the menu's action, both reached the herd; a junk place and a foe place were refused; the Add animals sheet lists every species and variant. Not checked: the Animals panel after an add, a full barn, a second player (non-admin refused by the server, not tried live).
notes: Changes the admin's own save, which decision 0038 kept out of the admin menu; recorded in 0049. SHANNON settled it on 2026-11-15: live for the owner only (isAdmin).
